narrative_prose: Hector squinted through the polarized brass visor, watching the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea tear the metallic waves into violent, jagged peaks. The scent of raw ozone and burning copper insulation filled the air, while the deafening roar of the shear wave drowned out the howling wind. He felt the static shock through his heavy boots, the metallic taste of ambient electricity on his tongue, and realized he had to quickly CONCEAL the primary data drive to DEFEND it from the surging magnetic field. Surging forward against the magnetic resistance, he waved a flare to ATTRACT Kaio's attention, practically tackling his squadmate to hand off the brass baton.
